name: SAPPHIRE
full_name: Spin Amplifier for Particle PHysIcs REsearches
summary: A quantum-sensing project using long-lived nuclear spins to amplify weak dark-matter pseudomagnetic fields, also studying novel spin interactions.
detection_principle: Hyperpolarized nuclear spins preamplify a resonant dark-matter field, read out by an alkali-metal atomic magnetometer.

results.summary: Laboratory coupling limits are obtained in the target interval, reaching approximately 2.9×10⁻⁹ GeV⁻¹ at 67.5 feV (95% CL).

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
